title: Day 1: Setting Up Your Environment
description: Install necessary tools and set up your development environment.
learningGoal: Be able to run a simple program in your chosen language.

title: Day 2: Hello World
description: Write your first program that prints 'Hello, World!'.
learningGoal: Understand basic syntax and output.

title: Day 3: Variables and Data Types
description: Learn about variables, strings, numbers, and booleans.
learningGoal: Declare and use variables of different types.

title: Day 4: User Input
description: Create a program that takes input from the user.
learningGoal: Read and process user input.

title: Day 5: Simple Calculations
description: Perform arithmetic operations and display results.
learningGoal: Use operators for math calculations.

title: Day 6: Conditional Statements
description: Use if-else statements to make decisions in your code.
learningGoal: Control program flow with conditions.

title: Day 7: Loops
description: Learn to repeat actions with for and while loops.
learningGoal: Iterate over a range of values.

title: Day 8: Arrays
description: Store and manipulate lists of data using arrays.
learningGoal: Create, access, and modify array elements.

title: Day 9: Array Methods
description: Explore built-in array methods like push, pop, shift, unshift.
learningGoal: Manipulate arrays with common methods.

title: Day 10: Functions
description: Break your code into reusable functions.
learningGoal: Define and call functions with parameters.

title: Day 11: Function Return Values
description: Learn how functions can return values.
learningGoal: Use return statements to get results from functions.

title: Day 12: Object Basics
description: Create and use objects to store related data.
learningGoal: Define object properties and access them.

title: Day 13: Object Methods
description: Add functions as properties to objects.
learningGoal: Call methods on objects.

title: Day 14: String Manipulation
description: Learn to concatenate, slice, and search strings.
learningGoal: Process and format text data.

title: Day 15: String Methods
description: Explore built-in string methods like toUpperCase, split, replace.
learningGoal: Transform strings using various methods.

title: Day 16: Introduction to Debugging
description: Learn basic debugging techniques to find and fix errors.
learningGoal: Use console.log and breakpoints to debug code.

title: Day 17: Working with Numbers
description: Explore mathematical operations and number formatting.
learningGoal: Perform advanced calculations and format numbers.

title: Day 18: Date and Time
description: Work with dates and times in your programs.
learningGoal: Create, format, and manipulate date objects.

title: Day 19: Randomization
description: Generate random numbers and use them in your programs.
learningGoal: Add randomness to your applications.

title: Day 20: Beginner Project - Calculator
description: Build a simple calculator that performs basic operations.
learningGoal: Apply learned concepts to create a functional application.

title: Day 21: Intermediate Concepts - Scope
description: Understand variable scope and closures.
learningGoal: Manage variable visibility in different code blocks.

title: Day 22: Recursion
description: Learn how functions can call themselves.
learningGoal: Solve problems using recursive functions.

title: Day 23: Higher-Order Functions
description: Pass functions as arguments and return functions from functions.
learningGoal: Use functions like map, filter, reduce.

title: Day 24: Map and Filter
description: Transform and filter arrays using map and filter methods.
learningGoal: Process collections with functional programming techniques.

title: Day 25: Reduce Method
description: Accumulate array values into a single result using reduce.
learningGoal: Summarize data with the reduce method.

title: Day 26: Destructuring
description: Extract values from arrays and objects into distinct variables.
learningGoal: Unpack data structures concisely.

title: Day 27: Spread and Rest Operators
description: Use ... to expand arrays/objects and collect function arguments.
learningGoal: Combine and split data structures easily.

title: Day 28: Error Handling
description: Use try-catch blocks to handle exceptions gracefully.
learningGoal: Prevent crashes and handle errors properly.

title: Day 29: Modules and Imports
description: Organize code into reusable modules and import them.
learningGoal: Split code across multiple files and share functionality.

title: Day 30: Intermediate Project - Todo App
description: Build a todo application with add, remove, and mark complete features.
learningGoal: Apply intermediate concepts to create a stateful application.

title: Day 31: Asynchronous Programming
description: Learn about callbacks, promises, and async/await.
learningGoal: Handle asynchronous operations without blocking execution.

title: Day 32: Fetch API
description: Make HTTP requests to retrieve data from servers.
learningGoal: Communicate with REST APIs and handle responses.

title: Day 33: Working with JSON
description: Parse and stringify JSON data for data interchange.
learningGoal: Convert between objects and JSON strings.

title: Day 34: Local Storage
description: Store data persistently in the browser using localStorage.
learningGoal: Save and retrieve data between page reloads.

title: Day 35: Event Handling
description: Respond to user actions like clicks, keypresses, and form submissions.
learningGoal: Create interactive applications that respond to events.

title: Day 36: DOM Manipulation
description: Dynamically create, modify, and remove HTML elements.
learningGoal: Update the webpage content without reloading.

title: Day 37: CSS-in-JS
description: Apply styles dynamically using JavaScript.
learningGoal: Control element appearance programmatically.

title: Day 38: Animations
description: Create smooth transitions and animations using CSS and JS.
learningGoal: Enhance user experience with visual effects.

title: Day 39: Responsive Design
description: Make your applications work on different screen sizes.
learningGoal: Use media queries and flexible layouts.

title: Day 40: Advanced Project - Weather App
description: Build a weather application that fetches and displays real-time data.
learningGoal: Combine APIs, async handling, and DOM manipulation.

title: Day 41: Data Structures - Stacks
description: Implement and use stack data structures (LIFO).
learningGoal: Solve problems using stack operations.

title: Day 42: Data Structures - Queues
description: Implement and use queue data structures (FIFO).
learningGoal: Manage data in first-in-first-out order.

title: Day 43: Data Structures - Linked Lists
description: Create and manipulate linked lists.
learningGoal: Understand pointer-based data structures.

title: Day 44: Data Structures - Trees
description: Work with tree data structures and traversal algorithms.
learningGoal: Navigate hierarchical data efficiently.

title: Day 45: Data Structures - Graphs
description: Implement graphs and explore traversal techniques.
learningGoal: Model and analyze networked data.

title: Day 46: Sorting Algorithms
description: Implement and compare different sorting algorithms.
learningGoal: Arrange data efficiently using various sort methods.

title: Day 47: Searching Algorithms
description: Learn linear and binary search algorithms.
learningGoal: Find data quickly in sorted and unsorted collections.

title: Day 48: Recursion Optimization
description: Optimize recursive functions with memoization and tail recursion.
learningGoal: Improve performance of recursive solutions.

title: Day 49: Design Patterns - Singleton
description: Implement the Singleton pattern to ensure single instance.
learningGoal: Control object creation and access.

title: Day 50: Advanced Project - Chat Application
description: Build a real-time chat application with websockets.
learningGoal: Apply advanced concepts to create interactive real-time apps.

title: Day 51: Testing Fundamentals
description: Write unit tests to verify your code works correctly.
learningGoal: Create automated tests for your functions.

title: Day 52: Testing Frameworks
description: Use testing frameworks like Jest or Mocha.
learningGoal: Structure and run tests efficiently.

title: Day 53: Debugging Tools
description: Use browser dev tools and debuggers effectively.
learningGoal: Inspect and debug applications in real-time.

title: Day 54: Performance Optimization
description: Identify and fix performance bottlenecks.
learningGoal: Make applications run faster and smoother.

title: Day 55: Code Refactoring
description: Improve code structure without changing functionality.
learningGoal: Write cleaner, more maintainable code.

title: Day 56: Version Control with Git
description: Learn Git basics for tracking code changes.
learningGoal: Manage code history and collaborate with others.

title: Day 57: Git Branching and Merging
description: Work with branches and merge changes effectively.
learningGoal: Manage parallel development streams.

title: Day 58: Deployment Basics
description: Deploy your applications to hosting platforms.
learningGoal: Make your applications accessible online.

title: Day 59: Final Project Planning
description: Plan and design your capstone project.
learningGoal: Scope and architect a complete application.

title: Day 60: Capstone Project
description: Build and present your final project incorporating all learned skills.
learningGoal: Demonstrate mastery of the full curriculum.
